output: **Claude finished @tmjssz's task in 3m 50s** —— [View job](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-wallet-monorepo/actions/runs/29101914232) --- ### Claude PR Review Nice, self-contained addition — the guarded dynamic import + inlined `NEXT_PUBLIC_IS_PRODUCTION` check is a clean pattern, and the `applyFeatureOverrides` prod short-circuit + `useChain`/`useChains` integration means all ~134 `useHasFeature` consumers pick up overrides for free. A few things worth improving before merge: #### Potential issues - **`FeatureFlagEditor.tsx:59` — switch does not clear an override when returned to config value.** `onCheckedChange` always dispatches `setOverride`, so toggling a row off then on again leaves it "overridden — matches current chain" (green rail + check indicator) instead of returning to a clean, non-overridden state. Users who use the switch as their primary control will accumulate silent overrides that only display as `matchesCurrentChain: true`. Consider auto-dispatching `clearOverride(feature)` when the new value equals `configValue` — matches the "revert override" affordance and prevents this drift. [Fix this →](https://claude.ai/code?q=In%20apps%2Fweb%2Fsrc%2Ffeatures%2Ffeature-flags%2Fcomponents%2FFeatureFlagRow.tsx%20around%20line%2059-63%2C%20the%20Switch%20always%20dispatches%20setOverride.%20When%20value%20%3D%3D%3D%20row.configValue%2C%20it%20should%20dispatch%20clearOverride(row.feature)%20instead%2C%20so%20toggling%20back%20to%20config%20fully%20clears%20the%20override%20(same%20effect%20as%20the%20revert%20button).%20Update%20FeatureFlagRow.test.tsx%20to%20cover%20this%20behavior.&repo=safe-global%2Fsafe-wallet-monorepo) - **`useFeatureFlagEditorData.ts:32-49` — reads raw chain data, not overridden.** The editor's rows show the *raw config-service* value in `configValue` and `chainScope`, but `useHasFeature` (and everything gated by it) shows the *overridden* value. That's the intended split — but it means the "Config service" column is not affected by overrides even though the switch below it is. Worth a quick doc-comment on `useFeatureFlagEditorData` explaining that `data` here is deliberately un-overridden (the whole point of the editor is to show what the config service delivered vs. your local value). - **`FeatureFlagRow.tsx:65-78` — hidden Check inside Tooltip.** Using `visibility: hidden` on the trigger with `aria-label` set is subtle: `visibility: hidden` removes the element from both hit-testing *and* the a11y tree, so the tooltip and aria-label are effectively dead when `matchesCurrentChain` is false. That is what you want, but a screen reader user will never hear "Matches config service setting for the current chain" even when it *is* matching, because the `aria-label` is on the icon while the accessible content is inside `TooltipContent` (only exposed on focus/hover). Consider either (a) using `sr-only` text alongside the visible check for reliable a11y, or (b) dropping the `aria-label` on the icon since `TooltipContent` already carries the announcement. - **`featureFlagOverridesSlice` runs in production.** The reducer is registered unconditionally in `store/index.ts:67` and included in `persistedSlices` (`:95`) + `broadcastState`. `applyFeatureOverrides` is a hard prod no-op, so behavior is fine — but the reducer, persisted state, and broadcast channel still ship. Small cost only; worth flagging that a stale `featureFlagOverrides` localStorage entry (e.g., from prior staging use on the same origin) will silently sit there in prod forever with no way to clear it via UI. - **`bundleExclusion.test.ts:18` — marker string is not distinctive enough.** `"local feature-flag overrides"` is generic enough that a future unrelated copy change could accidentally satisfy or invalidate the test. Consider a longer, editor-only sentinel (e.g., the full `AlertTitle` string `"Development tool."` combined with the class name, or a dedicated hidden `data-*` attribute in the editor JSX) to make the assertion robust. #### Test coverage gaps - No unit test for `FeatureFlagEditor` (search filter, "Reset all overrides" enable/disable + dispatch, empty overridden section). - No unit test for `FeatureFlagSection` (returns null when `rows.length === 0`). - No test that `applyFeatureOverrides` handles a chain with an override for a feature not in `Chain['features']` enum type (cast to string is safe but worth a coverage anchor). #### Nits - `FeatureFlagRow.tsx:58` — `` as an alignment spacer is a bit magic; a comment already exists on the grid but this bare span could get lost in future edits. - `useFeatureFlagEditorData.ts:53` — sorting inline via `localeCompare` is fine, but `FEATURES` is already a fixed enum; alphabetizing at module scope once would avoid re-sorting on every render. - `SafeSidebarContent.tsx:114-123` — `selectOverrideCount` subscribes the sidebar to the store in production even though the group is hidden. It's cheap, but you could hoist the `IS_PRODUCTION` check above `useAppSelector` if you're willing to accept a conditional-hook pattern (or leave as-is; noise-level). --- - [x] Fetch PR diff & metadata - [x] Read key files - [x] Analyze code quality, bugs, perf, security - [x] Post review · [Branch](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-wallet-monorepo/tree/feat/feature-flag-editor)
